zh-CN.name: ClawFounder
zh-CN.description: 面向创业者的 AI 协作工作台，围绕 workspace、容器与多 Agent 流程，帮助用户更高效地推进想法、项目与产品原型。

zh-CN.name: NoteRx
zh-CN.description: 专为小红书创作者打造的 AI 爆款笔记诊断与优化系统，结合数据分析与多智能体协作，为内容提供更具针对性的改写建议。

zh-CN.name: ClawGuard
zh-CN.description: 围绕主机安全、环境审计与风险检查设计的项目，用更自动化的方式帮助用户理解系统暴露面与运行风险。

zh-CN.name: Claude Image
zh-CN.description: 教 Claude Code / Codex 用好 gpt-image-2 的 Agent Skill 包，围绕意图优先的提示词、批量生成与视觉自检，把图像生成封装成可复用的工作流。

zh-CN.name: Claude in Box
zh-CN.description: 把 Claude Code 装进 Docker 的便携开发环境，支持多会话、Hook 驱动、Web 管理与透明 SOCKS5 代理，甚至能直接跑在树莓派上。

zh-CN.name: WebMC
zh-CN.description: 用 WebGPU 从零实现的网页版 Minecraft（clean room），直接在浏览器里渲染和探索体素世界。

zh-CN.name: TypeBox
zh-CN.description: 纯本地、离线优先的浏览器工具箱：Markdown 编辑器、图像套件、音视频工作台（ffmpeg.wasm）、Python IDE 与开发者工具，文件默认不出设备。

zh-CN.name: CNCDraw

zh-CN.name: Hachimi

zh-CN.name: AIDocGenius
zh-CN.description: 一个围绕文档理解、总结与结构化输出构建的 AI 工具项目，用于提升阅读和处理复杂文档的效率。

zh-CN.name: FileHelper Chatbot
zh-CN.description: 结合文件助手与对话能力的聊天机器人项目，让文件处理、摘要与互动问答形成闭环。

zh-CN.name: OI Wiki Contributions
zh-CN.description: 参与算法与竞赛知识社区建设，持续输出可复用的知识内容与技术说明。

en.name: ClawFounder
en.description: An AI collaboration workspace for founders, centered around workspaces, containers, and multi-agent workflows to move ideas and product prototypes forward.

en.name: NoteRx
en.description: An AI note diagnosis and optimization system for Xiaohongshu creators, combining data analysis and multi-agent workflows to improve content quality and direction.

en.name: ClawGuard
en.description: A security-focused project for host auditing, exposure review, and risk inspection, helping users understand system posture more automatically.

en.name: Claude Image
en.description: An Agent Skill package that teaches Claude Code / Codex to use gpt-image-2 well — intent-first prompting, batch generation, and visual self-check, turning image generation into a reusable workflow.

en.name: Claude in Box
en.description: A portable Claude Code dev environment in Docker — multi-session, hook-driven, web-managed, with a transparent SOCKS5 proxy, light enough to run on a Raspberry Pi.

en.name: WebMC
en.description: A clean-room, browser-based Minecraft built from scratch with WebGPU, rendering and exploring a voxel world right in the browser.

en.name: TypeBox
en.description: A local-first, offline browser toolkit — Markdown editor, image suite, audio/video workbench (ffmpeg.wasm), Python IDE, and developer tools. Files never leave your device by default.

en.name: CNCDraw
en.description: A Python toolkit for pen plotters / writing machines: a custom .tfont trajectory font format, layout and G-code generation (Grbl/EBB/Marlin), camera closed-loop calibration, with a FastAPI web UI and MCP agent tools.

en.name: Hachimi
en.description: A lightweight, Agent-style Android voice assistant that can replace the system assistant, built for earbuds / smart glasses: low-latency step-by-step voice reports, fully customizable SLM/ASR/TTS/tools/MCP, and a capability-based security sandbox.

en.name: AIDocGenius
en.description: An AI tool project focused on document understanding, summarization, and structured output for better knowledge workflows.

en.name: FileHelper Chatbot
en.description: A chatbot project that combines file assistance with conversational interaction to close the loop between files and answers.

en.name: OI Wiki Contributions
en.description: Ongoing contributions to algorithm and competitive programming knowledge infrastructure through open-source documentation work.
